overall_goal: Roast the dosa, fold it, and remove it from the pan

goals.description: Loosen the dosa from the pan and attempt to fold it
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to check, loosen, and try to fold the dosa, but it begins to break.

goals.description: Scrape the broken dosa from the pan and transfer it to a plate
goals.rationale: The person clears space on the counter, brings a plate closer, and scrapes the broken pieces of dosa off the pan onto the plate.
The person uses a knife to scrape off the bits of dosa stuck to the spatula.

goals.description: Loosen and attempt to fold another dosa
goals.rationale: The person slides the spatula under the dosa to lift and fold it, but it breaks down again.

goals.description: Turn off the hob and transfer the remaining broken dosa to the plate
goals.rationale: The person turns off the heat, moves the pan to the plate, and scrapes the rest of the broken dosa onto the plate.
